) VALUES ( #{name}, #{no}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{isCollege}, #{address}, #{degree}, #{graduationDate}, #{clazzId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE student
name = #{name},
no = #{no},
gender = #{gender},
phone = #{phone},
id_card = #{idCard},
is_college = #{isCollege},
address = #{address},
degree = #{degree},
graduation_date = #{graduationDate},
clazz_id = #{clazzId},
violation_count = #{violationCount},
violation_score = #{violationScore},
update_time = #{updateTime}
WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE student SET violation_count = #{violationCount}, violation_score = #{violationScore}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE clazz_id = #{clazzId}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.no, s.gender, s.phone, s.id_card, s.is_college, s.address, s.degree, s.graduation_date, s.clazz_id, s.violation_count, s.violation_score, s.create_time, s.update_time, c.name AS clazzName FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND s.no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{no}, '%')
AND s.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND s.clazz_id = #{clazzId}
AND s.gender = #{gender}
ORDER BY s.update_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.no, s.gender, s.phone, s.id_card, s.is_college, s.address, s.degree, s.graduation_date, s.clazz_id, s.violation_count, s.violation_score, s.create_time, s.update_time, c.name AS clazzName FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.no, s.gender, s.phone, s.id_card, s.is_college, s.address, s.degree, s.graduation_date, s.clazz_id, s.violation_count, s.violation_score, s.create_time, s.update_time, c.name AS clazzName FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT CASE degree WHEN 1 THEN '初中' WHEN 2 THEN '高中' WHEN 3 THEN '大专' WHEN 4 THEN '本科' WHEN 5 THEN '硕士' WHEN 6 THEN '博士' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM student WHERE degree IS NOT NULL GROUP BY degree ORDER BY degree ASC
